titles.title: The Brother Who Does It All

description:
“I told you to be careful around guys. Where did you meet a piece of trash like that?”

The first love who left 15 years ago has returned.   
Right in the middle of being dumped by her boyfriend.   

“I was so curious about how you turned out, and you’re still the same. Have you been well?”

Even though he left without a single word after making a promise.   
Her face turned cold with a sense of betrayal.

“Our Seul is really sulking. You're not going to see Oppa anymore?” 
“Yes. It’s been a really long time since I stopped seeing you, so I don't see any reason why I should start again.”   
“That’s a big problem. I keep seeing Na Yoon-seul not as a younger sister, but as a woman.”

His gaze somehow looked resolute.

“Seul, should we live together? Or how about marriage?”   
“Just like when we played house, I'll even be your husband.”
